text:
Ivy_CS: Heads-up — Sunbeam Health onboarding hit some edge rate limits during today's prep runs. They're doing two demos across regions tomorrow (EU morning, LATAM afternoon) and asked if we can do short-lived regional pins + ephemeral allowlists so their demos don't tail off. Renewal meeting in 3 days so this matters. Can ops help? :slightly_smiling_face:
Diego_CSM: Important — if both demos look good we'll probably pull Sunbeam from at-risk->on-track. Please include a 1-line note for AE on what changed.
Noah_Ops: We can handle it. Proposal: create two ephemeral windows: one pin to eu-north-1 for the EU demo, one pin to sa-east-1 for LATAM demo. Add per-window allowlist IPs and use header matching to scope to demo traffic only. Auto-revoke both allowlists after 6h. Suggest burst_rps 950 for EU window and 700 for LATAM. Fallbacks: eu-west-1 @ 200ms p50 for EU, us-east-1 @ 220ms p50 for LATAM.
Ivy_CS: Demo clients: EU runners 198.51.103.12 / 198.51.103.13 with header X-SB-Demo: eu. LATAM runners 203.0.113.99 / 203.0.113.100 with header X-SB-Demo: latam. Windows are non-overlapping: EU 08:30-11:00 UTC, LATAM 16:00-18:00 UTC.
Rosa_Engineer: Header routing supported. I'll push header-match rules for both values and validate on staging. ETA ~25m for rule push + smoke. Question: do you want a single config change with two windows or two separate change_ids?
Noah_Ops: Prefer two change_ids (easier to revoke individually and keep audit clean). I'll include change_ids in the snippet. Also we should warm KV cache separately for each window.
Hector_SRE: Recommend pre-warm 15m before each window. I'll run the synthetic warmups and watch p95 and token spend. Rollback criteria: p95 regression >12% from baseline OR token cost spike >18% during warmup. Also add short-lived alerting channel to the change (ops-alerts) for the window.
Ivy_CS: Good. Can you paste exact snippets you'll apply so I can add to the AE enablement note and renewal tracker?
Noah_Ops: Pasting planned configs below. I'll apply EU change at 2025-05-06T08:30:00Z and LATAM change at 2025-05-06T16:00:00Z unless anyone objects.

```
# change_id: 4287654321-eu-pin
customer: "sunbeam"
allowlist_ips: ["198.51.103.12/32","198.51.103.13/32"]
rate_limit: {region: "eu-north-1", burst_rps: "950", window_start: "2025-05-06T08:30:00Z", window_end: "2025-05-06T11:00:00Z", autorevoke_ttl: "6h"}
routing: {match_header: {name: "X-SB-Demo", value: "eu"}, primary_region: "eu-north-1", fallback: "eu-west-1", fallback_latency_ms: "200"}
notes: "EU demo; pre-warm KV cache at T-15m; ops-alerts channel active"
```

```
# change_id: 4287654321-latam-pin
customer: "sunbeam"
allowlist_ips: ["203.0.113.99/32","203.0.113.100/32"]
rate_limit: {region: "sa-east-1", burst_rps: "700", window_start: "2025-05-06T16:00:00Z", window_end: "2025-05-06T18:00:00Z", autorevoke_ttl: "6h"}
routing: {match_header: {name: "X-SB-Demo", value: "latam"}, primary_region: "sa-east-1", fallback: "us-east-1", fallback_latency_ms: "220"}
notes: "LATAM demo; pre-warm KV cache at T-15m; ops-alerts channel active"
```

Rosa_Engineer: Snippets look good. I'll push the header-match rules to staging now and run smoke tests (latency, 5xx, token spend). Will report back with short logs.
Hector_SRE: I'll schedule warmups at 08:15Z and 15:45Z and add temporary alerting for both windows. If rollback criteria hit, I'll announce here and revoke immediately.
deploy-bot: change_request sunbeam-4287654321-eu-pin queued for manual approval by Noah_Ops at 2025-05-06T08:10:00Z
deploy-bot: change_request sunbeam-4287654321-latam-pin queued for manual approval by Noah_Ops at 2025-05-06T15:40:00Z
Noah_Ops: Approved both change_requests. EU pre-warm scheduled 08:15Z, apply 08:30Z. LATAM pre-warm scheduled 15:45Z, apply 16:00Z. I'll post staging smoke + live smoke and revoke timestamps here.
Diego_CSM: Noted and added renewal tracker entry: "Sunbeam Health: dual-region demos with ephemeral rlift/allowlists; success reduces renewal risk." I'll join both demos and collect PM feedback for the renewal dossier.
Ivy_CS: Thanks team — please @channel any major regressions during windows. I'll capture demo feedback and paste notes here afterward.
